retainedFailures.detail: First amendment rejected existing bold **Documentation** prefix; prefix-token emphasis restored, without stripping surrounding prose.
First whole-paragraph single-prefix rule over-withheld adjacent complete Documentation/Getting Started rows; cached complete-row classification preserves both.

additionalBeforeObservation.detail: Old frozen binary admitted third-party docs-intro + later bare URL; current binary rejects same input.

limits: Bounded lexical source association; no complete Markdown/HTML semantic ownership proof.
A complete standalone/nav/badge declaration is treated as an author declaration, independent of domain.
Complete direct declaration rows are classified once in the cached paragraph; a paragraph containing other prose retains its full subject.
Prefix eligibility is exact after one list marker and optional prefix emphasis/terminal period; broader true prose may abstain.
Own docs-intro continuation is a bounded set of neutral/current-project phrases, not an arbitrary subject parser.
Existing per-physical-line link helper complexity is unchanged; the cache control is not a universal complexity proof.
No replacement URL inference, URI resolution, confidence promotion, target runtime/version check, or whole crawler refresh.
Original record/source freezes and historical failure receipts remain unchanged.
